issues.description: Farm.addAnimal has conflicting return types across artifacts: the UML diagram specifies `addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean`, but the reference solution implements `public void addAnimal(Animal animal)`. This makes it unclear whether students must return the success flag from `List.add(...)` (as per UML) or implement a void method (as per solution/tests).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across UML, template expectations, and solution. Preferred: change solution to `public boolean addAnimal(Animal animal) { return animals.add(animal); }` (and update template accordingly). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to specify a `void` return type.
